raw.submission_details: The four main conferences of ETAPS 2027 solicit contributions. ESOP accepts regular research papers (max 25 pp), experience reports (max 15 pp), and fresh perspectives (max 15 pp). FoSSaCS accepts regular research papers (max 18 pp). TACAS accepts regular research papers, case study papers, and regular tool papers (max 18 pp), and tool demonstration papers (max 6 pp). All page limits exclude the bibliography. Submissions must be in English, original, unpublished, and not submitted elsewhere. Simultaneous submission is forbidden. ESOP, TACAS, and FoSSaCS use an author rebuttal phase. Data availability statements are mandatory. Double-blind reviewing applies to TACAS and iFS regular research papers.
